description: Two lines, and the pen down

participation.context: Wrote the fourteen lines for his own mouth, and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote the opening last, showed yourself the two lines the page must keep, and put the pen down.

title: Wrote the fourteen lines and stopped

participation.context: Filled the bracket, and did not cross the river.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote the one word and the two sentences under it, and you noted a bill you did not follow.

title: Wrote dignitie into the March gap
